description: Structured ingestor for Claude Code session JSONL exports. Extracts PostToolUseFailure events and maps them to the blocker schema. Stage001 is the bounded shell: parse, filter, map — no ledger writes, no pattern clustering, no /mnt/data access.

does: Accept a JSONL chat export (one JSON object per line)
Validate each line as parseable JSON
Map each PostToolUseFailure entry through post_tool_failure_adapter.map_payload (no ledger writes)
Emit a mining receipt: entries_seen, parse_errors, failures_found, mapped, unmappable, events
does_not: Write to the blocker ledger (no recurrence tracking in Stage001)
Access /mnt/data or any mounted OS path
Claim to have fully mined the actual chat790 export
Perform pattern clustering, frequency analysis, or RCA candidate ranking
Fetch from network or external sources
Modify any existing governance artifacts or hook scripts

future_stages: STAGE002: ledger feed — pipe mapped events through adapt_and_classify to track recurrence across export entries
STAGE003: pattern analysis — cluster by fingerprint, compute frequency, emit ranked RCA candidate list
STAGE004: full chat790 export ingestion with session-aware deduplication and cross-session recurrence tracking
